name: Content Writing
tagline: Research a topic and draft an article using your source material and style guide.

useCases.title: Researched blog post
useCases.description: Research a topic, draft a long-form post in your house style, and list the source for each claim.

useCases.title: Brief to outline
useCases.description: Turn a one-line content brief into a detailed outline with sections, key points, and a suggested angle for you to approve.

useCases.title: Whitepaper and report sections
useCases.description: Draft sections of a long report from your research, with consistent terms.

useCases.title: Repurpose into a newsletter
useCases.description: Take an existing long article and reshape it into a newsletter issue that keeps the voice but fits the shorter format.

useCases.title: Content gap analysis
useCases.description: Scan your published library for topics you have not covered and suggest new pieces with working titles.

useCases.title: Draft into your CMS
useCases.description: A workflow researches, drafts, and saves the piece to your CMS through a connected app.

faq.q: Will the writing match our brand voice?
faq.a: Yes. Add your style guide and published articles to a Space, and Ryu drafts from them, so tone and terminology stay consistent.

faq.q: Can it research and cite sources?
faq.a: Yes. With connected tools and MCP, Ryu can pull facts from the web and your own material and attribute each claim, so an editor can verify before publishing.

faq.q: Does Ryu write the whole piece for me?
faq.a: No. Ryu writes a researched first draft; a writer shapes the angle, sharpens the prose, and fact-checks before anything ships.
